content: Papillomatosis is skin surface elevation caused by hyperplasia and enlargement of contiguous dermal papillae.[1] These papillary projections of the epidermis form an undulating surface under microscopic examination.

Papillomatosis is skin surface elevation caused by hyperplasia and enlargement of contiguous dermal papillae.[1] These papillary projections of the epidermis form an undulating surface under microscopic examination.
